display_title: Could the Boy Next Door be a Vampire?
description:
Navigating the uncertainty of early adulthood is no easy feat, as Hong Woo-Ree is realizing on his year off from college. Not only is he trying to make it as a published author, but he also thinks that his best friend, Gong Min-Nee, is a vampire! After making some flawed assumptions, Woo-Ree believes that Min-Nee's secretive behavior comes from hiding his "true" identity-- he's completely unaware that Min-Nee isn't actually a vampire, and just has a huge crush on him. While Woo-Ree struggles to get his writing published and protect Min-Nee's "secret," Min-Nee must find a way to confess his feelings for the oblivious Woo-Ree. Will these two be able to reconcile their misunderstandings and allow for a real relationship to blossom?

(Source: Tappytoon)
